title: Uncertainty-Aware ControlNet: Bridging Domain Gaps with Synthetic Image Generation
mechanism: A semantic ControlNet trained on labelled masks and an uncertainty ControlNet trained on labelled + unlabelled images (conditioned on the segmenter's mean entropy) are fused at sampling, giving labelled images in the unlabelled domain's style.
adaptation: LDM fine-tuned on the 11.9k pool (1-ch to 3); semantic ControlNet on 478 train masks; uncertainty = house 5-seed ensemble mean entropy per cell (high on half-cut/scuff CSIR); sample entropy from the half-cut pool; feed half-cut-cropped train masks so layout and style move toward E1. Use for inactive, scuff context, layout; latent 64x64 means crack pixels must pass an adherence check.
min_experiment: PF + 2,000 generated half-cut-style cells vs PF, 5 seeds. Metric E1 crack relF1@2 and E1 inactive IoU; guard test crack IoU clean 49. Kill: both E1 gains < +0.03 or test crack IoU drop > 0.01.
evidence: R: retinal OCT Spectralis (labelled) to Home-OCT (unlabelled), about 10k B-scans per domain at 256 px; abstract reports significantly improved segmentation without target labels; also Cityscapes to ACDC. Numbers not read.
prior_overlap: Synthetic half-cut views (geometry only) were n.d.; generated target appearance never tried. Open.
